pipeline.modality: Drug-device combination product (small-molecule chemotherapy delivered via Trans-Arterial Micro-Perfusion (TAMP) using the RenovoCath catheter)
pipeline.target: Local-regional delivery of gemcitabine to pancreatic tumor vasculature
pipeline.license_origin: Internally developed; gemcitabine is generic; RenovoCath device is RenovoRx-developed

indications.indication: Locally advanced pancreatic cancer (LAPC) following induction chemo/radiotherapy
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 randomized, open-label, multi-center trial of intra-arterial gemcitabine (via RenovoCath) vs IV gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel following radiotherapy in LAPC; primary endpoint overall survival.
key_milestones: FDA Orphan Drug Designation (pancreatic and bile-duct cancer)

commercial_product.name: RenovoCath
commercial_product.indication: Temporary vessel occlusion (arteriography, preoperative occlusion, chemotherapeutic drug infusion)

excluded_preclinical.asset: TAMP platform expansion (lung, brain, colorectal, soft-tissue sarcoma)
excluded_preclinical.reason: Shown on pipeline diagram but no clinical-stage trials yet.
